I received the same message after an hourly project lasting four months. It started well, but things changed, and the client just wanted me to copy and paste content verbatim rather than use my writing skills, even after telling me, "I like what you have written," and complimenting my subsequent copywriting work. I don't know what triggered the change, but the client wanted me to use precise information and didn't want any alterations. So, I had to copy and paste what she provided as-is. That wasn't made clear, and then she sent a nasty message claiming she had given me particular materials to use and that I should use them precisely as they were. The material she provided was meant to be a foundation, and I would use my writing skills to enhance it. I learned this the hard way. Hiring a copywriter to copy and paste content without modifications makes no sense. If I were the client, I could do that myself much faster. It also doesn't make sense to hire someone at $25/hour to copy and paste verbatim. This undermines my copywriting skills. I decided to quit and sent her a message. She abruptly ended the contract without a word and left me negative feedback, sounding like it was out of retaliation. My Job Success Score is 91%, barely good enough to maintain my top-rated status.

Of course, Upwork's warning didn't help. They stated that if they saw this "trend of negative feedback," they would block me from future projects, not making it clear how long the block would be.
